mainEntity.name: When is drywall sanding a DIY job, and when should I hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a professional makes sense when the room is large, the finish needs to look very smooth, or you have repeated problems like visible seams, tape ridges, or damaged paper. A pro can usually correct unevenness faster and reduce the risk of over-sanding.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is fine for small repairs, but larger rooms, smooth-finish expectations, or repeated seam problems are better handled by a pro. It reduces the risk of over-sanding and rework.
